title: A WONDERFUL introduction to Seville
text: A great way to discover Seville without having to follow a large group. Having a private guide makes the experience much more personal and allows you to discover the city’s history, beautiful landmarks and local traditions at a comfortable pace. Highly recommended for the beginning of your stay in Seville!
author: C6027NXlaurad

title: A 10/10 experience!
text:
Taking a tour of Seville with Bárbara is a great choice. She is a charming, approachable, and very professional guide who manages to convey her passion for history and the city in an enjoyable and entertaining way.

Her explanations are clear, interesting, and full of curiosities that make you enjoy the tour much more. Furthermore, it is clear that she knows Seville perfectly and that she enjoys sharing everything she knows.

Without a doubt, a highly recommended experience both for those visiting Seville for the first time and for those who want to know its history and its corners better.
author: josemarinac
